_about: Template for your own app. Copy it with `python3 wsm.py new <name>`, then replace every CHANGE_ME (README: Use it on your own app).
_hosts: Host of the WebSocket, as `wsm.py inspect` shows it. Empty = any host (fine for the first capture).
_frame: Which frame drives the screen and where its list is. `wsm.py inspect` prints this block, paste it here.
_fields: The field map: what each field of one list item does on the screen. Fill it before the presets, a mock is only as right as this map. Key = path inside one item (dotted or /pointer). Value = what it drives, the values it takes, and how you know: spec, dev, or tried (checked on the screen with `wsm.py set`). `wsm.py fields` shows it next to the real values.

fields.CHANGE_ME_FIELD: CHANGE_ME: what it drives on the screen, its values (spec / dev / tried)

_presets: One preset per state from your design/spec. Each preset = the real item `source` cloned with this patch. Patch only the fields that make the state.
_rules: Scenarios for this app. The built-ins (frozen, duplicate, slow, late-frame, reverse, empty) already work, nothing to add for them.
_push: What `wsm.py inject` changes in the last real frame before pushing it into the open socket.
